# Parley v0.1.47

One change: the New Pane Folder menu stops offering folders that no longer
exist, and a new **Manage Folders…** sheet lets you see and prune the lists.
v0.1.46, released a few minutes earlier, changed only the checks.

## Folders that no longer exist are never offered

The menu's Recent section kept listing a folder for weeks after it had been
deleted, and there was no way to remove it. Recent history is automatic, so
it is now pruned of missing folders when Parley starts and every time a
folder is added, and the menu checks again as it opens. Favourites are your
bookmarks, so a missing one is never removed for you; it is left out of the
menu and shown as MISSING in the manager instead.

## Manage Folders…

At the bottom of the New Pane Folder menu. It lists Favourites and Recent
with their full paths, marks a deleted one MISSING with Use disabled, and
offers Use for New Panes and Remove on every entry, plus Add Favourite and
Clear Recent. Removing an entry forgets it in Parley and changes nothing on
disk. The menu itself also gains Clear Recent Folders under the Recent
section.

## Compatibility

Nothing else changed. Agent protocol unchanged at 32. Your existing favourites
and recent history are read as before; the first launch drops any recent
entry whose folder is gone.

Validated: 347 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build. The pruning check was watched failing with pruning disabled. Not
driven by hand: the sheet in the running app; it is the P2.2 step to try
first.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
